influences.name: Lady Gaga
influences.context: the first concert I ever bought tickets to go and see with my friends was a Lady Gaga show in Cape Town. It was her Monster Ball world tour, and it was electrifying.

influences.name: Taylor Swift
influences.context: I mean, in a delusional way, I would say Taylor Swift, because I saw her doing it when I was 14 and immediately thought 'I can do this'

influences.name: Stevie Wonder
influences.context: 'Isn't She Lovely' by Stevie Wonder. I used to dance around my childhood living room with my family while that song played in the background, so it's very nostalgic.
